notes: Authoritative numbers for docs/balance/FRAMEWORK.md and TAXONOMY.md. Designed values only; every bible-fixed number is marked source:'bible'.
Units: distance in terrain cells (x1024 at load), time in seconds (ceil to 20 TPS ticks at load), speed in cells/s, percentages as integers.
Keys ending _pct are integer percents; *_bp are basis points (1/100 %). Keys ending _s are seconds; _cells are cells; _cells_s are cells per second.
The data_balance loader may reshape this file but must keep the numbers; tools/py/balance_calc.py validate is the acceptance test.
Top-level keys are documented in docs/balance/FRAMEWORK.md section 4.2; enums and the damage matrix rationale in docs/balance/TAXONOMY.md. Integer indices are frozen (append only).
null build_time_s (headquarters) is the bible's null: the HQ is never queued, it is deployed from an MCV (3 s).

damage_types.label: Armor-piercing warhead (cannon, AT missile, naval gun, torpedo)
High explosive / fragmentation (artillery, bombs, flak, demolition)
Solar/thermal beam (Sunlance, Ifrit, Sunwall, Dawn, Helios)
Strategic kinetic penetrator / mass driver (Atlas, Horizon)
Electromagnetic disable (Aurora); never reduces health below 1

armor_classes.label: APC/scout chassis, buggies, self-propelled artillery, collectors
T3 tanks, walkers, crawlers, assault carriers
Gunships, bombers, EW aircraft, cargo aircraft
Escorts, monitors, arsenal ships, carriers, submarines
Factories, refineries, labs, airfields, docks, turrets, advanced defenses

resistance_rules.formula: final = (raw * matrix_pct * (100 - res_pct) * falloff_pct + 500000) / 1000000, min 1 when raw>0 and matrix_pct>0
resistance_rules.interception: projectile removal is separate from resistance and exempt from the cap (bible); Trident strategic packets: -50% at 8 charges, never removed

amphibious.note: deep = 70% default; per-unit override deep_speed_pct (Tide Tank 60, PD Collector 70 by bible)

naval.note: units with radius >= 0.9 cells are deep-only

small_arms.notes: Rifle squads. volley = hits_per_volley bullets; may hit aircraft (matrix 65/25).

machine_gun.notes: APC/boat/tower MG. Same matrix behaviour as small_arms, higher range.

autocannon.notes: 30 mm class; used by fast scouts and gunboats; suppressive when flagged.

tank_cannon.notes: Standard direct-fire anti-armor gun. Homing (always hits a live target); 50% splash edge.

siege_gun.notes: Heavy HE assault gun (Colossus, Elephant, Gaj). Anti-structure specialist; ballistic (no lead).

demolition_cannon.notes: Kiln/Bear: short reach, very broad blast.

at_missile.notes: Guided anti-tank missile (infantry). Interceptable by APS and Trident (ordinary missile).

aa_missile.notes: Guided anti-air missile. Air targets only.

flak.notes: Air-burst flak; dual-purpose variants add ground layer (light infantry).

artillery_shell.notes: Howitzer shell. Indirect: needs spotting; no lead on movers.

rocket_barrage.notes: Salvo of small rockets; wide scatter.

missile_artillery.notes: Precision missile artillery; ballistic ('ordinary missile' for APS/Trident).

beam_thermal.notes: Continuous thermal beam; damage applied every 5 ticks; ramp (focus) raises damage on a single target.

rail_gun.notes: Hitscan slug; single target; no splash; long reload.

torpedo.notes: Anti-ship / anti-submarine; travels under water; cannot hit land.

emp_pulse.notes: Area disable field (Aurora); non-lethal damage + status.

breach_charge.notes: Anti-building charge (Aguila); only structures (ground layer, armor class building_*/fortress).

naval_gun.notes: Ship main gun; anti-ship and shore support.

drone_missile.notes: Carrier / swarm drone missile (drone HP is the weak point).

camouflage.source: bible: 6 s, detector radius 5, Dune Rover reveal 6 s

heal_aura.note: medic/technician baseline 2.0 %/s in 4 cells; bible upgrades quote 1 %/s references

interception.source: bible: Ural 12 s, Arjun 15 s; never shells, beams or superweapons

sensor.source: bible: Civic puck 4 cells/20 s/30 s; Fen mast 6 cells

transport.source: bible: APC 2, Okapi 3, Leviathan 4, Landing Transport 4 squads or 2 vehicles

scaling.power_index: PI = HP^a_hp * DPS^a_dps * range^a_range * speed^a_speed * vision^a_vision (exponents per family in archetypes.*.power_exponents)
scaling.build_time: build_time_s = cost / production_rate_cr_per_s[producer/tier], rounded to 0.5 s; per-unit override allowed within +-20%

tolerances.note: A designer's unit passes lint when each stat is inside its band around the family reference AND the fair-cost deviation is within power_index_pct

headquarters.note: Free when preset; via MCV deploy otherwise.

refinery.note: Completes with 1 free Collector; unload slot 1.

relay.note: NEC only; build time is ours (bible null).

structures_source_note: cost, build_time_s and power_delta of shared structures and the Relay cost are bible values; health/armor/vision are ours; footprints, exits, aprons and pads follow docs/CONTRACT_DATA.md section 5.4 (airfield 6x3 with 4 base pads, anti_tank_turret 1x1); Relay build time and HQ deploy are ours.

bulwark_cannon.note: slow traverse; poor vs infantry by matrix

lance_rail.note: single target; very long range; long reload

sunwall_projector.note: beam ramps 130 -> 250 DPS on one target

forge_cannon.note: rapid cycling; shorter range than rail

bastion_missile_tower.note: 2 x 550 burst then long reload; no AA

budget.rule: Average across the eight advanced defenses: 1.30..1.65 break-cost ratio vs T2 tanks (balance_calc.py defenses). Burst/long-reload designs trade sustained DPS for alpha; short-range or minimum-range designs trade it for reach.
budget.note: power ratio = (HP*DPS)^0.5/cost relative to same-cost mobile units of the same role; keep within 1.15..1.35

inf_line.notes: Line/rifle squad. One entity; view shows ~4 soldiers (2 damage packets per volley, >= 25 per hit).

inf_at.notes: Anti-tank team; must stop to fire (movement domain). 4 missiles kill a T1 tank (270 x 4 >= 900).

inf_support.notes: Unarmed T2 specialist (medic, observer, technician, operator, officer). Ability supplies value; observers/spotters use vision 12.

inf_combat_spec.notes: Armed T2 specialist (sapper, pioneer, reclaimer, breach team).

mbt_t1.notes: T1 medium tank: anchor of the whole framework.

mbt_t2.notes: T2 heavy MBT (Marte, Ural, Imperial Guard, Arjun, Rhino).

veh_aa.notes: Mobile AA + detector; optional weak ground MG (<=20% of AA DPS).

siege_he.notes: Heavy assault gun (Colossus, Elephant, Gaj, Kiln, Bear via tags).

siege_rail.notes: Long-range armor killer (Argent, Charlemagne): 874 per hit vs medium armor, two hits kill a T1 tank.

siege_demo.notes: Demolition crawler (Kiln, Bear): 4.5-cell reach, 2.5-cell blast, anti-structure specialist.

veh_command.notes: Crewed command walker: cannon + 5-cell command field.

veh_assault_carrier.notes: Leviathan: amphibious heavy carrier, short siege cannon, 4 squads.

air_drone.notes: Unmanned strike drone: one 4-missile salvo per sortie.

ship_carrier.notes: Carrier: 6 drones (weapon lives on the drones).

ship_sub.notes: Missile submarine: torpedo + surfaced land-attack missile.

mbt_t2_rail.notes: T2 rail tank (Rhino): accurate anti-armor, weak vs infantry via matrix.

veh_aa_beam.notes: Laser AA (Dawn): continuous thermal beam, air only, 140 raw DPS.

veh_aa_flak.notes: Dual-purpose flak (Porcupine): 62 DPS vs air_light, 104 vs infantry.

style_tags.note: Tags change stats only. Abilities cost credits via ability_value_pct. Effects multiply.

ability_value_pct.note: Percent added to the fair cost. detector is baseline for scouts/AA/escorts (0).

faction_styles.note: A faction style is only a summary plus power_offset_pct (filled from modifier_compensation.recommended). Passive bible modifiers are applied by the resolver and are never pre-baked into base numbers. Unit flavour is expressed with style_tags/abilities per unit_assignments.

movement_defaults.note: 'slow acceleration' (Marte) = accel_ticks 14 on a medium hull; values are ours (bible silent)

deposit.note: Finite. A load of 600 empties exactly one cell. 3 collectors drain a standard field in ~6.3 min.

map_budget.layout: per player: 2 standard start fields (28.8k) + natural expansion 1 standard + 1 rich (33.6k) + 2 further standard (28.8k) + 2 contested rich centre fields shared (38.4k)
map_budget.note: Sum of deposits a player can reach without crossing the map centre; finite deposits (not the clock) end matches at 20-35 min.

expansion.note: Buildings must be inside an HQ's 8-cell radius (bible), so an expansion needs an MCV.

salvage.note: AE only; track share of total income (bible prototype priority 5)

unit_cap.note: Typical 25-min army 40-70 entities; cap bounds sim cost, not economy.

power.rule: generators = ceil(draw * 1.10 / (150 * output_multiplier)); the superweapon alone draws 200 = 1.33 generators (800 credits); defense_avg = 25 power

unprotected_value_ratio.note: ground value destroyed per first sortie / aircraft cost, no AA

aircraft.ammo_rule: a sortie ends when ammo_volleys is 0; the aircraft returns to the nearest powered Airfield pad, rearms rearm_s_full, then resumes
aircraft.note: Fighters cannot attack ground; AA weapons cannot attack ground; small arms hit air at bullet matrix 65/25.

channel_width_cells_min.note: river widths the map generator should provide for navigability

naval.note: Ships are a side theatre: no baseline economy needs water (bible). Naval siege range 20 outranges howitzers (15) by 5 cells, so coastal defenses are answered by aircraft, submarines or own ships.

artillery.targeting_rule: indirect weapons may target anything visible to the owner (any friendly sight); the shell lands on the target's position at fire time (no lead).
artillery.note: A 15-cell howitzer needs a spotter about 7 cells ahead of it: a scout (vision 12) then reaches 19 cells; own vision 8.5 only sees the first 8.5.

carriers.note: Bible leaves drone pricing unresolved (selector.unmanned_combat_units): ours = 120 credits per replacement drone, 14 s; PD/JP research scales the time.

design_targets.direct_hit_key_building_kill: Atlas 3 rods kill one 3x3 production building; fortress-class needs 2 shots
design_targets.note: see FRAMEWORK sec. 5.11; measured by balance_calc.py sw

rps_equal_cost.metric: remaining cost share of A minus remaining cost share of B (-1..+1)
bands: T3 beats T1 at equal cost (tier premium)
T2 beats T1 at equal cost
unescorted howitzers lose to a tank charge

defenses.note: pair = anti_tank_turret + watchtower (1250) vs T1 tanks; advanced (1800) vs T2 tanks; ratio = attacker cost / defense cost at break-even

structure_kill.note: a T1 tank army costing as much as the building destroys it in this window

superweapon.note: value = credit-weighted damage on the reference layouts at optimal aim without evasion; buildings count 100 % only when killed, else 25 %

pacing.windows_semantics: [physical lower bound, latest allowed for the fastest plan, latest allowed for the balanced plan] in seconds from match start
pacing.notes: Lower bounds are the pure production chain with unlimited credits (Gen 25 + Refinery 40 + Factory 40 + Radar 30 ...). Plans: balance_calc.py PLANS.

modifier_compensation.policy: Passive bible modifiers are NOT baked into base stats. The raw roster index (balance_calc.py modifiers) is compensated 60 % through a faction-wide power offset (HP and DPS, never cost or time) and, for subfactions, an extra offset on the two unique units.

elasticity.note: value of a +1 % stat change in % of army power; stats not listed use the per-archetype power_exponents (hp, dps, range, speed, vision); cost enters as 1/cost

valuation.note: Reference army = the roster's units in 13 role slots weighted by slot_weights (renormalised over the slots present); a stat change moves the index by weight x elasticity.
